init_hook: echo 'Welcome to the allsearch devbox! Run `devbox run test` to run the tests.'

setup: devbox services up -b || echo 'devbox services are already running'
create_schemas: PGPORT=${PGPORT:-5432} createuser allsearch -w || echo 'db user already exists'
PGPORT=${PGPORT:-5432} createdb allsearch_development -O allsearch || echo 'dev db already exists'
PGPORT=${PGPORT:-5432} createdb allsearch_test -O allsearch || echo 'test db already exists'
reset_db: PGPORT=${PGPORT:-5432} dropdb allsearch_development || echo 'dev db already dropped'
PGPORT=${PGPORT:-5432} dropdb allsearch_test || echo 'test db already dropped'
create_solr_cores: until curl --output /dev/null --silent --head --fail http://localhost:${SOLR_PORT:-8983}/solr; do sleep 1; done
delete_solr_cores: curl -X POST http://localhost:${SOLR_PORT:-8983}/api/cores/catalog/unload -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"deleteIndex":true,"deleteDataDir":true,"deleteInstanceDir":true}' || echo 'catalog core was already deleted'

curl -X POST http://localhost:${SOLR_PORT:-8983}/api/cores/dpul/unload -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"deleteIndex":true,"deleteDataDir":true,"deleteInstanceDir":true}' || echo 'dpul core was already deleted'

curl -X POST http://localhost:${SOLR_PORT:-8983}/api/cores/findingaids/unload -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"deleteIndex":true,"deleteDataDir":true,"deleteInstanceDir":true}' || echo 'findingaids core was already deleted'

curl -X POST http://localhost:${SOLR_PORT:-8983}/api/cores/pulmap/unload -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"deleteIndex":true,"deleteDataDir":true,"deleteInstanceDir":true}' || echo 'pulmap core was already deleted'
